bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test -f "$P/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" || exit 31
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 32
echo "GAYBBS_IMAGE_CURRENT=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}' | cut -c1-27)"
echo "GAYBBS_IMAGE_PREVIOUS=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-apply-entry-6229feb --format '{{.Id}}' | cut -c1-27)"
CID=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$CID" | grep -c .)" = 1 || exit 34
echo "GAYBBS_CONTAINER_IMAGE=$(docker inspect "$CID" --format '{{.Image}}' | cut -c1-27)"
echo "HOST_PROJECT_SHA=$(git -C "$P" rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "USERBOT_ACTIVE=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)"
echo "GAYBBS_STATUS=DIAG_READONLY_PASS"
